policy:
WEATHER & AIR QUALITY POLICY (Nilgiri Valley School)
1. Outdoor activities (sports, assembly in the ground, field trips) are moved indoors or postponed if ANY of these is forecast for the activity time: US AQI above 200; maximum temperature above 40 C; chance of rain 60% or more; or rain of 10 mm or more in the day.
2. If US AQI is forecast above 300, or rain of 50 mm or more in the day, the principal decides whether to close school or shift to online classes. The assistant may only RECOMMEND this, never announce it.
3. If rain of 20 mm or more is forecast at any bus stop on a route, parents on that route are told to expect delays of up to 30 minutes.
4. Messages to parents are short (under 60 words), polite, in English and Hindi, and are sent only after the principal approves them.
5. Never share one student's details with another student's parent.
